text:
hugo: Morning — quick async check-in for today's content-launch runway. What I did: uploaded final hero image variants to the CDN, queued benchmark post draft in Notion, ran token cost estimates for the 3 headline variants. Blockers: still waiting on eng for perf numbers on embedding generation for the week-long campaign; need final embed latency to tune batching. Today: coordinate with @sam for perf, @olivia for microcopy, aim to get launch checklist green by EOD.
sam: On it — I pushed a quick perf run to the staging cluster. Short results: embedding gen QPS ~220 on dedicated, median latency 45ms (p50 42ms p95 120ms). Pushed logs to /mnt/bench/2026-03-marketing.json. Dropping snippet: ```{ "qps":220, "p50":42, "p95":120 }```
hugo: nice, could you confirm batch size used? we need numbers for batch=16 and batch=64
sam: used batch=16 in that run. Re-running batch=64 now, ETA ~8m. pinging @jorge to make sure autoscaler won't preempt
jorge: saw the job, increased headroom on staging gpu pool by +1 for 30m. no preempt expected. :thumbsup:
olivia: microcopy ready — two variants attached in Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz. prefer shorter CTAs for mobile. I'll drop alt text for hero images in the Notion doc.
emma: marketing benchmark post draft looks good. small ask: include the embedding per-token cost in the 'cost comparison' table. I can edit if you want.
hugo: please do. also @devon — any legal review needed for campaign claims? last time we had to tweak the wording.
devon: quick review ok, just avoid absolute claims like 'fastest' unless we have head-to-head with competitor. I'll do a final pass in the PR.
sam: batch=64 run done: QPS 540, median latency 78ms, p95 210ms. attaching short log: ```curl -s http://staging/bench?run=1932 | jq .summary```
deploy-bot: infra-deploy-staging succeeded for commit 7a3f4e2 — snapshot created at s3://redwood-staging/snapshots/1932102468.tar.gz
hugo: sweet, with these numbers we'll use batch=64 for headline A and batch=16 for mobile fallback. I'll update Notion and tag everyone. Blockers cleared for now. EOD goal: final publish.
sam: FYI I'll open a tiny PR to add the benchmark table to the blog. expect review in ~30m.
olivia: will also prepare mobile hero with alt text. sending draft in 20.
devon: I'll queue final legal note in the PR. small change expected.
hugo: thanks all :rocket:
